long: Argument is the slot number from the in-progress section of 'quests'. Marks the row ABANDONED rather than deleting it, preserving the audit trail and the (char, zone, id) unique key.
name: abandon
summary: Drop an in-progress quest.

long: FieryMUD legacy: aborts the spell you're currently casting and clears any spell queued behind it. Today's runtime resolves casts immediately and has no queue, so abort has nothing to do — kept as a registered command name for muscle memory and to provide a clear message instead of 'Unknown command'. Use 'cancel' to drop a non-permanent buff already on you.
name: abort
summary: Cancel an in-progress cast or queued spell.

long: Joins the inviter's group and starts you following them. No-op if you have no pending invite.
name: accept
summary: Accept a pending group invite.

long: Read-only summary of who you're logged in as and which character is currently active. Snapshot taken at login — characters created mid-session won't appear until you reconnect. Also reads 'discord_links' and 'google_links' for your Users row and prints whatever's bound; Discord links display as 'verified' / 'unverified' so you can tell whether the bot will honor messages from the linked account. ('whoami' is a separate one-line identity command.)
name: account
summary: Show your account email, role, character roster, and linked Discord/Google.

long: Read-only display of 'Users.account_wealth'. Every character on this account sees the same pool; pair with 'account_deposit' / 'account_withdraw' to transfer between the per-character bank ('balance') and the shared pool.
name: account_balance
summary: Show the account-shared bank balance.

long: Source is your 'bank' balance, not on-hand. Refuses if your per-character bank can't cover the amount. After success every online character on this account sees the new shared pool size.
name: account_deposit
summary: Move copper from per-character bank to the shared pool.

long: Inverse of 'account_deposit'. Refuses if the shared pool can't cover the amount. Cross-character sync runs after the transfer — all sibling characters online refresh their view of the pool.
name: account_withdraw
summary: Move copper from the shared pool to your per-character bank.

long: Filter by category: combat, exploration, social, crafting, misc. Unlocked entries show with a tick; locked-but-visible ones with a placeholder. Hidden achievements stay invisible until unlocked — those are the spoiler ones.
name: achievements
summary: List your unlocked achievements (and visible-but-locked ones).

long: Coder+ (level 104+) only. Bumps the target's XP to the threshold for <level> and runs the standard level-up loop, so HP/stamina max + practice points scale through the normal path. Refuses level decreases (those need a separate 'delevel' path).
name: advance
summary: Set a player's level (admin level-up).

long: Marks you AFK so others see the indicator on 'who' and on incoming tells. Run again to come back.
name: afk
summary: Flip your away-from-keyboard flag.

long: Lists every mob anywhere in the world that has you in its hate list (most recent swing first) or its memory (mobs you've fled from that will re-engage on sight). Mobs in your current room are flagged so you know what's about to swing. Mirrored as a 'Char.Aggro' GMCP frame on each prompt for HUD-style clients.
name: aggr
summary: Show what's hostile to you right now.

long: Immortal+. With no argument, lists every mob in the room with its alignment and aggression formula and reports whether it would attack you. 'aggrodebug on' makes the server log every aggression check (target 'aggression', level info) until 'aggrodebug off'.
name: aggrodebug
summary: Analyse aggression in this room, or toggle aggro logging.

long: The opposite of 'rest': you drop the resting stance and sit at attention. Does nothing if you are already alert.
name: alert
summary: Stop resting and pay attention, without standing up.

long: With no args, lists every alias you've defined. With 'alias <name>', shows that alias's expansion. With 'alias <name> <command>', sets the alias ('unalias <name>' removes it). A plain alias replaces whatever you type (extra words are dropped). Put '$*' where the rest of your line should go, '$1'..'$9' for single words, and ';' between commands to chain them: 'alias gg get all corpse;put all bag' or 'alias k kill $1;kill $2'. An alias never re-triggers itself, so 'alias look look $*' wraps the real command. Aliases persist across sessions.
name: alias
summary: Define a command shortcut.

long: Builder+. Lists abilities from the ability catalog. Abilities with no effects are flagged (NO EFFECTS). Default limit 50.
name: alist
summary: List loaded abilities with optional filters.

long: Implementor-only. Effect name is matched against the EffectCatalog. Default duration 60s.
name: apply
summary: Spawn an effect on a player.

long: Immortal+. Flips Characters.name_approved to true for the named character. Removes the NameApprovalPending marker on the live entity if they're online and DMs them. No-op against an already-approved character. Pair with 'reject_name <char> <new>' if the name needs to change.
name: approve_name
summary: Approve a pending character name (keep the name).

long: Lists every area open to players, with its zone number. Give some text to list only the areas whose name contains it, e.g. 'areas forest'.
name: areas
summary: List the areas of the realm.

long: Coder+. Re-reads every ability (with restrictions, effects, targeting, saves, components, damage components and messages) and the effect catalog, then swaps them into the running server.
name: areload
summary: Reload the ability and effect catalogs from the DB.

long: Builder+. 'asearch fire' matches ability names; '--effect heal' finds abilities applying an effect of that type; '--no-effects' finds abilities that would cast but do nothing.
name: asearch
summary: Search abilities by name, effect type, or find broken ones.

long: Targets a single mob in the room and fires its SPEECH-flagged Lua bodies with the topic in the 'speech' Lua global. Bystanders see that you asked something but not what.
name: ask
summary: Ask a mob about a topic — fires SPEECH triggers.

long: Looks up <player> in your current room, finds whom they're fighting, and engages that target — same stamina cost and rules as 'attack'. Refused if they're not fighting, if their target is gone, or if you're already fighting someone else.
name: assist
summary: Engage your ally's current target.

long: Builder+. Looks up the ability by name (or id) and shows its school, cost, duration, restrictions, linked effects.
name: astat
summary: Dump an ability's metadata.

long: Builder+. The location takes the same forms as 'goto': a room id in your zone, '<zone> <id>' or '<zone>:<id>', 'home', or the name of a player or mob (their room). You are moved there for the one command and put back afterwards, with no poof messages. If the command moves you (goto, a teleport) you stay where it left you; if you die you stay where you died. Moving ends any fight you are in, as it did in the legacy 'at'.
name: at
summary: Run a command as if you were standing somewhere else.

long: Implementor only. 'attach mtr 30:5 guard' bolts trigger 30:5 onto the mob 'guard'; otr takes an object name, wtr a room as 'zone:id'. The change is live only: it is not saved, and a respawned mob starts over with its prototype's triggers. <position> is 0 for the front of the list, otherwise the index to insert at (default: the end). The trigger's own type has to match: mtr for a mob trigger, otr for an object trigger, wtr for a world trigger.
name: attach
summary: Attach a trigger to a live mob, object or room.
usage: attach { mtr | otr | wtr } { zone:id } { name | room } [ position ]

long: Match is by case-insensitive substring on visible names. Targets with combat stats will fight back. Combat resolves once per second on the world tick.
name: attack
summary: Engage a target in melee combat.

long: Sets AUTO_ASSIST. While you stand in the same room as someone you follow, or a member of your group, you automatically engage anyone who attacks them, whether a player or a monster starts the fight. You do not join when you are already fighting, are asleep or resting, or the attacker is not in your room.
name: autoassist
summary: Toggle automatically joining fights against the one you follow.

long: When set, the room description is followed by the same line 'exits' would print. Already consumed by the look path.
name: autoexit
summary: Toggle automatic exit listing on 'look'.

long: Sets AUTO_GOLD. Coins from mobs you kill jump straight to your purse without taking the items (autoloot already collects coins too).
name: autogold
summary: Toggle automatic collection of coins from kills.

long: Sets AUTO_LOOT. Items and coins from mobs you kill jump straight to you. Coins respect autosplit.
name: autoloot
summary: Toggle automatic looting of kills (items and coins).

long: Sets AUTO_SPLIT. Coins you take from a corpse, the floor or an autolooted kill are split evenly with the groupmates standing in the room; you keep the remainder. Use 'split <amount>' to divide coins by hand.
name: autosplit
summary: Toggle automatic splitting of coins you pick up.

long: Deals 2x your damage on the opening swing and engages the target. Refused if you're already fighting (the target sees you coming) or if your target is already in combat with someone else.
name: backstab
summary: Surprise opener for double damage; out-of-combat only.

long: Read-only display of the 'bank_wealth' column from your character row. Pair with 'deposit' / 'withdraw' to move coin to / from the bank.
name: balance
summary: Show your bank-stored coin.

long: Implementor-only. Looks up the player by name, resolves the owning Users row, inserts a BanRecords row. The login flow refuses any of that account's characters until 'unban' lifts.
name: ban
summary: Ban a player's account.

long: Heals 10 HP at a cost of 4 stamina. With no arg or 'me'/'self', bandages yourself. Otherwise tries to find the target in your room. Refused while fighting and refused on full-HP targets.
name: bandage
summary: Apply first aid for a small heal (out of combat).

long: Deals weapon damage + 3 and forces the target into a sitting posture. Targets without combat stats simply take the damage.
name: bash
summary: Slam a target, knocking them off their feet.

long: Costs 8 stamina, spawns a 'berserk' EffectInstance on yourself for 60s. Refused if already berserk. Combat damage scaling is a follow-up — for now this is the visible buff state.
name: berserk
summary: Self-buff: rage state for 60s.

long: With just an alias, lists messages newest first (sticky-marked entries float to the top). Append a slot number to read that message's body.
name: board
summary: List or read messages on a board.

long: Each board has an alias ('mortal', 'god', 'quest', etc.) and a title. Use 'board <alias>' to list messages on one.
name: boards
summary: List every public message board.

long: Dispatches the BREATHE_* ability your race grants (the DRAGONBORN_* races carry one, per the RaceAbilities table; 'innate breathe fire' works too). Refuses for races with no breath weapon. Drains 6 stamina; the actual damage / target gating runs through the data path.
name: breathe
summary: Dragonborn breath weapon — race-typed.

long: Decrements your on-hand coin by 'amount' (copper units) and pads the target mob's coin by the same. Fires the target's BRIBE-flagged Lua triggers with 'actor' = you and 'amount' as a Lua global so bodies can react proportionally.
name: bribe
summary: Hand a sum of copper to a mob — fires BRIBE triggers.

long: When on, 'look' skips the full room description and shows just the title + exits + occupants.
name: brief
summary: Toggle terse room descriptions.

long: Drains 5 stamina and dispatches the BUCK skill at the named target. The schema's data path runs 'dismount' (forced=true) → clears Mounted/RiddenBy, then 'knockdown' (duration=1) → drops the target's posture. v1 dispatches as a player skill so characters with BUCK trained (Sorcerer/Druid/etc.) can fire it; mob-AI usage waits for an autonomous ability scheduler.
name: buck
summary: Throw a rider — dismount + knockdown.

long: Logs a feedback row to the 'Reports' table. Body captures your name + character_id + room + the text. Empty messages refuse so we don't fill the table with noise.
name: bug
summary: Report a bug to the staff.

long: Argument is either the catalog index from 'list' or a substring of the item's name. Coin is deducted from your 'wealth'; the item lands in your inventory. Stock is advisory until per-shop instance state lands.
name: buy
summary: Buy an item from the shopkeeper here.

long: Every mob following you (pets, hirelings, charmed creatures) that isn't already in your room leaves whatever it was doing and joins you. A mount you are riding is left alone.
name: call
summary: Call your followers to your location.

long: Refuses indoors, in cities, on water, in the air, while mounted, or while in combat. Once setup completes (~35 seconds), you're saved and leave the game, to return right here. Walking away or being attacked aborts the camp.
name: camp
summary: Pitch camp, then save and leave the game.

long: With no arg, lists the effects you can cancel. With an effect name (a prefix works; quote multi-word names), ends that beneficial spell on you right away, exactly as if it had worn off. Permanent effects (racial or from gear) and harmful ones cannot be cancelled, and you cannot cancel while fighting.
name: cancel
summary: Drop one of your own timed beneficial spells.

long: Acrobatic attack that evades while striking. Requires an active fight; strikes your current opponent using the CARTWHEEL ability from the database.
name: cartwheel
summary: Tumble past your foe with an acrobatic strike.

long: Looks up a SPELL by case-insensitive name (partial match accepted). For now this is a stub: prints the ability's metadata so you can see what's in the catalog. Real effect application — slot consumption, restriction checks, damage/heal/buff resolution — lands when CharacterAbilities and the effect pipeline are wired. Only matches abilityType = SPELL; for chants and songs use 'chant' / 'perform'.
name: cast
summary: Cast a spell from the loaded catalog.

long:
Implementor-only.
- 'create' opens a new clan; name + abbrev must both be unique.
- 'assign' puts a character into a clan, defaulting to MEMBER. Rank can be LEADER / OFFICER / MEMBER / APPLICANT.
- 'kick' removes their clan_member row entirely.
- 'motd' sets a clan's message-of-the-day; empty text clears it.
name: cclan
summary: Manage clans (create / assign / kick / MOTD).
usage:
cclan create <name> <abbrev>
       cclan assign <player> <abbrev> [rank]
       cclan kick <player>
       cclan motd <abbrev> <text>
       cclan disband <abbrev>

long: Same shape as 'cast' but filters to abilityType = CHANT. Stub: prints metadata and gates on KnownAbilities, no effect application yet.
name: chant
summary: Invoke a chant from the catalog (cleric-side spells).

long: Like 'spells' but filtered to kind=Chant. Default shows only chants you've learned; 'chants all' dumps the catalog. Use 'chant <name>' to invoke.
name: chants
summary: List chants you know (or the full catalog).

long: Clients that don't announce UTF-8 support get plain ASCII: dashes, arrows, stars and box-drawing characters are replaced by look-alikes (-- -> * + - |). If your client does display UTF-8, 'charset utf8' turns the real symbols on; 'charset ascii' forces plain text; 'charset auto' follows what your client reports. Saved with your character. 'charset' alone shows the current setting.
name: charset
summary: Choose plain ASCII or UTF-8 output.

long: Shows every item any character on this account has stored. 'chest deposit <item>' stores an item (same as 'chest_deposit'); 'chest withdraw <number>' takes the numbered item back (same as 'chest_withdraw').
name: chest
summary: List items in your account-shared chest.

long: Moves the named item from your inventory into the account-shared chest, where any character on this account can take it back via 'chest_withdraw'. Refuses SOULBOUND and NO_DROP items.
name: chest_deposit
summary: Store an inventory item in the account chest.

long: Withdraws the item with the given number (see 'chest' for the listing; numbering starts at 1). The item is spawned back into your inventory with its per-instance state (charges, liquid level) restored.
name: chest_withdraw
summary: Take an item back from the account chest.

long: Prints clan name + abbreviation + MOTD plus the roster (sorted leader→officer→member, then by level desc, then name). Online members are marked with a '*'. Refused for players not in a clan. Subcommands: 'clan motd <text>' (LEADER / OFFICER), 'clan kick <player>' (LEADER).
name: clan
summary: Show your clan's info, MOTD, and roster.

long: Gated on knowing the Claw skill (legacy grants it to animal shapechange forms). Counts as a violent opening — engages the target if you're not already fighting them. Random damage scaled by your level.
name: claw
summary: Slash with bestial claws.

long: Reports your active character, role, session uptime (since login), and idle time (since the last command typed). Terminal capabilities — color depth, dimensions, MCCP — aren't tracked in the runtime today; the full RFC-1408 telnet negotiation would lift them off the wire.
name: clientinfo
summary: Show this session's connection info.

long: Builder+. Pairs the class plain name with its numeric id (the value 'Profile.class_id' carries) so you can plug it into 'set' / 'skillset' / 'advance' paths.
name: clist
summary: List every class with its catalog id.

long: Refused if the exit has no door, is already closed, or doesn't exist.
name: close
summary: Close an open door in the given direction.

long: Sends the ANSI clear-screen + cursor-home escape sequence. Cosmetic only; no game state changes.
name: cls
summary: Clear the terminal screen.

long: The server asks your client what it can display and adapts: 256-color and truecolor shades are mapped to the nearest of the 16 basic colors for clients that only do 16. 'color off' removes color entirely, 'color 16' / 'color 256' / 'color truecolor' pin a depth if your client misreports itself, and 'color auto' goes back to following the client. Saved with your character. 'color' alone shows the current setting.
name: color
summary: Choose how much color you see.

long: The server wraps room descriptions, help and other prose to your client's reported window width (80 if it doesn't report one). 'columns 100' wraps narrower than the window, which reads better on very wide windows (a value wider than your window is capped to it); 'columns auto' goes back to following the client. The setting is saved with your character. 'toggle columns <n>' works too.
name: columns
summary: Set the width long text is word-wrapped to.

long: Shows just the names you have access to, without the per-category framing 'help' uses. Aliases share their primary name's slot. With a category arg (info / movement / communication / combat / admin) the list is filtered to that category, useful when the full 200+ command roster is overwhelming.
name: commands
summary: Flat alphabetical list of every command you can use.

long: Sets COMPACT. Renderers that respect it tighten their leading whitespace.
name: compact
summary: Toggle compact output (suppresses leading blank lines).

long: Each item is matched by keyword the same way 'wear' matches. Both items must be on you (inventory or equipped). With a single arg, the second item is inferred from whatever you're currently wearing in that item's wearable slot — handy for the "should I switch?" decision. Prints weight + level deltas, plus a weapon-damage row when both sides have non-zero average damage.
name: compare
summary: Compare two carried/worn items by weight, level, and weapon damage.

long: Drains 4 stamina and dispatches the CONCEAL skill via the data path. Spawns a 'hidden' status effect and installs the Stealth marker, which earns the opening-strike bonus. It does not raise your hiding: use 'hide' for that.
name: conceal
summary: Magical concealment — improved hiding.

long: Like 'meditate', but also grants a temporary Focus bonus (Intelligence / 4, at least 1) while it lasts. You sit down if standing. Cannot be used while fighting. Re-running 'concentrate' (or standing, or being drawn into combat) breaks your concentration.
name: concentrate
summary: Concentrate deeply to speed up spell memorization.

long: Sets CONSENT. Group invites and certain shared-effect spells will check this flag once those systems land.
name: consent
summary: Toggle consent for group/share interactions.

long: Sizes up the target — compares their HP, accuracy, evasion, and attack power against yours and reports a rough difficulty band. Doesn't engage the target; purely informational.
name: consider
summary: Size up a potential opponent.

long: Each line shows an ability name and its remaining cooldown in seconds, sorted longest-first. Empty when nothing is on cooldown.
name: cooldowns
summary: List abilities currently on cooldown.

long: Drains 4 stamina and dispatches the CORNER skill at the named target. Effect is a level-scaling physical-damage application like LURE; pin-in-place mechanics aren't modeled in the schema, so v1 is the damage hit and the engage.
name: corner
summary: Pin a mob with a hard hit to keep them in melee.

long: The gnomish racial Minor Creation, as its own command: 'create <item>' is 'innate minor creation <item>'. The same one-hour racial cooldown applies. Only races whose innate abilities include Minor Creation can use it.
name: create
summary: Gnomes: tinker an item together without a spell.

long: Acknowledges the project's antecedents.
name: credits
summary: Show contributors and credits.

long: Builder+. Case-insensitive substring against the class's 'plain_name'. Subclass rows are flagged.
name: csearch
summary: Find classes by name substring.

long: Broadcasts to every online clan member sharing your 'clan_id'. Refused for players not in a clan. Each line is rendered with the clan abbreviation prefix so cross-clan staff can tell the channels apart in 'wiznet' cross-traffic.
name: ctell
summary: Chat on your clan's private channel.

long: Real-world server time (UTC) and the in-game calendar date.
name: date
summary: Show the real-world server date and the in-game date.

long: Builder+ (level 101+) only. Drops the player's Connection so the network task closes the socket cleanly. The autosave path runs on disconnect, so progress is preserved.
name: dc
summary: Disconnect a player by name.

long: When set, you no longer receive 'gossip' or 'shout' from other players. Run again to hear them.
name: deaf
summary: Stop hearing room-wide channels (gossip, shout).

long: Clears the pending invite without joining. No-op if you have no pending invite.
name: decline
summary: Decline a pending group invite.

long: Hard-deletes the row. Slot number is the '#' from 'mailbox'.
name: delmail
summary: Delete a mail message by slot.

long: Hard-deletes the row at the given slot. Players can only delete posts they made (case-insensitive poster-name match); Builder-and-above can delete anyone's. Edit history ('BoardMessageEdit') cascades.
name: delpost
summary: Delete a board message (yours, or any if Builder+).

long: A bare number is copper ('deposit 100' is 100 copper); add a unit for more ('deposit 5 gold'), or say 'all'. Refuses if you don't have that much on hand. v1 is location-agnostic; banker-mob gating arrives once 'MobProfession::Banker' is hydrated.
name: deposit
summary: Move coin into the bank.

long: With no argument, prints your current description. With new text, replaces it (max 500 chars). With 'clear' / 'none' / '-', removes it. XML-Lite color tags render the same as room descriptions. Persists on disconnect.
name: description
summary: Show or set the prose 'examine' shows for you.

long: Implementor only. The trigger is 'zone:id', its place in the list (1 is the first), or a word of its name ('2.beggar' for the second match). 'all' removes every trigger. 'detach <target> <trigger>' finds the target itself, preferring what you wear or carry. Live only; nothing is saved.
name: detach
summary: Remove a trigger from a live mob, object or room.
usage: detach [ mob | object ] { target } { trigger | all }  |  detach room { trigger | all }

long: Implementor-only. With no argument, prints current state. With 'on' or 'off', flips the server-wide ''DevMode'' resource AND persists the new state to the ''GameConfig'' row ''server.dev_mode'' so it survives restarts. When ON, every connected player is treated as Implementor for permission checks AND dice rolls are visible regardless of the per-player SHOW_DICE_ROLLS flag. NEVER leave this on in prod. Each toggle logs a loud syslog warning.
name: devmode
summary: Toggle server-wide dev mode (open playtest).

long: With no arg, reports your own condition band (e.g. 'mortally wounded'), your raw HP / Stamina, and your posture. With a target, reports their condition band and posture only — exact numbers are private. Pair with 'glance' for a one-line summary or 'score' for the full sheet.
name: diagnose
summary: Verbose health readout for self or a target in your room.

long: Sets SHOW_DICE_ROLLS. Combat output surfaces hit/dmg rolls when the flag is set.
name: dice
summary: Toggle showing per-swing dice rolls in combat.

long: Removes the target's wielded item; the weapon drops to the floor where any combatant can pick it up. Default target is your current Fighting target. Costs 5 stamina. Refused if the target isn't wielding anything.
name: disarm
summary: Knock your opponent's weapon to the ground.

long: Breaks your group apart and drops everyone directly following you.
name: disband
summary: Dismiss your group and everyone following you.

long: Two-step verification: 'discord link <id>' mints a one-time code; you then echo '/verify <code>' into the configured gossip channel within 10 minutes. 'discord unlink' clears the binding immediately. 'account' shows the current state.
name: discord
summary: Bind a Discord account to this user.

long: Removes your Fighting state — you stop swinging. Opponents may keep attacking until they auto-disengage or you leave the room.
name: disengage
summary: Stop fighting your current target.

long: Equivalent to 'group dismiss <player>' — removes the target from your group and ends their follow link to you. 'disband' clears everyone at once.
name: dismiss
summary: Drop a single direct follower from your group.

long: Clears the 'Mounted' link on you and the 'RiddenBy' link on the mount. No-op when not mounted.
name: dismount
summary: Get off your current mount.

long: Drops the item in the current room with a giving message. A real donation-room flag lands later — for now, donated items sit on the floor.
name: donate
summary: Charitably leave an item for someone else.

long: Costs 10 stamina. Flips closed/locked exits to Open on both sides — useful when you don't have the key. Refused on already-open exits and when no exit exists in the named direction.
name: doorbash
summary: Force-open a closed or locked door.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: down
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Takes the target (an object or corpse in the room, or a sitting/resting player who has used 'consent') along when you walk in the given direction. You must be standing. Anything you could pick up (or any corpse) can be dragged, up to three times what you can carry, and heavy loads cost extra stamina. Only staff can drag mobs. Player corpses are only draggable by their owner.
name: drag
summary: Drag a corpse, object or consenting body with you.

long: Decrements the container's 'remaining' liquid by 4 units. Empty containers refuse. Use 'quaff' for potions, 'sip' for a smaller swig (1 unit), 'taste' to identify the liquid without drinking.
name: drink
summary: Take a swig from a drink container.

long: Match is by case-insensitive substring on keywords. The item is left in the current room; bystanders see you drop it.
name: drop
summary: Drop an item from your inventory onto the floor.

long:
Builder+.
  dtrig list <target>       - triggers attached to a mob/object
  dtrig info <zone:id>      - details, fire stats and recent errors
  dtrig fire <target> <id>  - run a trigger body with <target> as self
Trigger ids are 'zone:id' or a bare id in your current zone.
name: dtrig
summary: Debug triggers: list, inspect with errors, or fire.

long: Implementor-only. Useful for offline analysis. Path defaults to /tmp/world-dump-<ts>.json.
name: dumpworld
summary: Snapshot the entire entity store as JSON.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: east
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Despawns the food. Refused on non-food items. Effects (hunger, ConsumableEffects) are deferred.
name: eat
summary: Consume a food item from your inventory.

long: Builder+. Broadcasts the message verbatim (no speaker prefix) to everyone in the caster's room — useful for narrative prompts during live events. For a global broadcast, see 'gecho'.
name: echo
summary: Speak a god-line into your current room.

long: Pre-loads the existing subject and body into a composition session. Add lines to append, or '.clear' to wipe before writing the new body. Players can only edit their own posts; Builder+ bypasses the gate.
name: editpost
summary: Re-open a board post for editing.

long: Each line shows an effect name and its remaining duration in seconds (or 'permanent' if it has no timer).
name: effects
summary: List active effects on yourself.

long: Gated on knowing the Electrify skill (legacy grants it to the eel shapechange form). Electric strike — engages combat. Damage scales with level.
name: electrify
summary: Channel lightning into a target.

long: Your name is prepended. 'emote smiles broadly.' shows everyone (including you): 'Strider smiles broadly.'
name: emote
summary: Perform a third-person action visible to the room.

long: Your name plus 's is prepended. 'emote's eyes widen.' shows everyone (including you): 'Strider's eyes widen.'
name: emote's
summary: Perform a possessive third-person action visible to the room.

long: Reads the portal's 'Destination' and teleports you to the matching room. Refused while fighting. Portals with a missing or unresolved destination shimmer harmlessly.
name: enter
summary: Step into a portal in the room.

long: Shows each occupied slot and the item filling it.
name: equipment
summary: List items you are wearing/wielding.

long: Builder+. Search one table by a field. Run it with only a type (or 'esearch' / 'tsearch' with nothing) to list the fields. Text fields match a substring; 'name' fields match whole-word prefixes of the name and keywords. Number fields take 5, >5, <5, >=5, <=5, !5 or 5..9 (an inclusive range). Add 'in <zone>' at the end to stay in one zone. Flag fields (wear, extraflags, effflags, flags, type, size, sector, ...) take one or more flag names, abbreviations allowed, and match when every one is present. Output is capped at 100 rows. Shops, zones, reset commands and skills are not searchable here.
name: esearch
summary: Search room exits and doors by keyword, description, key or target.

long: Match by name or keyword (case-insensitive substring) on anything in your current room — mobs, other players, items, or equipped gear. Shows their long description.
name: examine
summary: Look closely at a person or thing in the room.

long: Converts coins between denominations at a banker. Rates: 10 copper = 1 silver, 10 silver = 1 gold, 10 gold = 1 platinum. Wealth is stored as a single copper total, so the exchange re-expresses your coins rather than changing your net worth; any remainder that doesn't fill a whole target coin is returned as change.
name: exchange
summary: Exchange coins at a money changer (banker).

long: Shows each direction with the destination room's name. Exits whose target room isn't loaded show as '(beyond)'.
name: exits
summary: List the exits from your current room.

long: Prints your level and total experience points. The per-level table that turns this into a 'to next' readout will land with the levelling system.
name: experience
summary: Show your current experience and level.

long: Puts out a held, worn or carried light source. Refused on items that aren't lit and on permanent lights, which cannot be put out.
name: extinguish
summary: Put out a lit torch or lantern.

long: Coder+. The C++ server watched zone files for changes. World data now lives in the database, so there are no files to watch; use 'reloadzone' instead.
name: filewatch
summary: Not applicable: world data is database-backed.

long: Inverse-arg 'pour': same liquid-match rules, transfers up to the destination's remaining capacity.
name: fill
summary: Top up a container from another container.

long: Builder+. Useful for testing trigger bodies. The 'actor' defaults to the caster.
name: firetrig
summary: Manually fire a trigger by id.

long: Drains 4 stamina and dispatches the FIRST_AID skill via the data path. Heal amount comes from the schema formula 'skill / 4' scaled by wisdom. Defaults to self when no target given. The shim gates 'Fighting' since first aid isn't an in-combat action.
name: firstaid
summary: Quick self/ally heal — wisdom-scaling.

long: Shows every flag currently set on you. Use 'toggle <flag>' to flip one on or off.
name: flags
summary: List your active player flags.

long: Picks an open exit at random and moves you through it. You stop fighting; attackers stop on the next combat tick (they auto-disengage when their target leaves the room).
name: flee
summary: Run away from combat through a random open exit.

long: Needs a source of flight (the fly spell, a winged form or a worn item). Movement charges a flat 2 stamina per move while flying — great savings over water/swamp (4-6 normally), slightly pricier on roads (1). Air rooms have no floor: anyone who is not flying falls through them, and so do loose items and corpses. Use 'land' (or 'walk') to come back down.
name: fly
summary: Take to the air (sets the Flying marker).

long: When the target moves, you move with them through the same exit. 'follow self' (or 'unfollow') stops following. Cycles are silently broken — you can't follow someone who is already following you.
name: follow
summary: Trail another character automatically.

long: Shows the players and creatures currently following you, where each one is, and how healthy it looks. 'pets' narrows the list to creatures.
name: followers
summary: List everyone following you.

long: Builder+ (level 101+) only. Dispatches <command> with <player> as the actor — exactly as if they had typed it.
name: force
summary: Make a player run a command as themselves.

long: There's no prepared-spell list to forget from. Spell slots are a circle-pool you draw from when casting; a slot you've spent regenerates on its own under resting / sleeping / meditating postures. Redirects to 'slots'.
name: forget
summary: (legacy alias) Slots aren't pre-prepared — see 'slots'.

long: Builder+ (level 101+) only. Frozen players can't input commands.
name: freeze
summary: Toggle a player's frozen state.

long:
Without args, prints every toggle the caller is allowed to see along with its current state. With a toggle name, prints just that toggle's state; add 'on' / 'off' to flip it. Implementor-only flips like ''devmode'' upsert the matching ''GameConfig'' row so the choice survives a restart.
Known toggles: devmode, pk, summon, charm, sleep, roomeffect, names, ooc.
name: game
summary: List or flip server-wide rule toggles.

long: Builder+. Bypasses Deaf / IgnoreList — gechoes are out-of-character announcements that should always reach the audience.
name: gecho
summary: Speak a god-line to every online player.

long: Match is by case-insensitive substring on the item's keywords (or its name). With 'from <container>', pulls from a container the player is carrying or one in the room. The item moves into your inventory; everyone else in the room sees the action.
name: get
summary: Pick up an item from the room or a container.

long: Both you and the target must be in the same room. The item must be in your inventory (not equipped — 'remove' first if needed).
name: give
summary: Hand an item to another character in the room.

long: Tells you the target's name, posture, condition (e.g. 'bleeding'), and whether they're fighting. Faster than 'examine' for a quick teammate / enemy check.
name: glance
summary: One-line condition check on someone in your room.

long: Visible to every online player who hasn't toggled their 'deaf' flag and isn't ignoring you. The dot alias ('.') lets seasoned players stack gossips without arrowing back to type the verb. A lone '.send', '.abort', '.preview' or '.clear' is a mail-editor word, not a gossip; use 'gossip <word>' to say one of them on the channel.
name: gossip
summary: Talk on the global gossip channel.

long:
Builder+ command. Three forms:

  goto <id>             — room <id> in your current zone
  goto <zone> <id>      — composite (zone, id)
  goto <name>           — teleport to a player or mob's room
  goto home            — your recall (home) room

Bypasses exits, doors, and no-teleport rooms. Rooms restricted to the god ranks stay closed to lower staff. Your 'poofout' / 'poofin' lines are shown to the rooms you leave and arrive in.
name: goto
summary: Teleport to a room by id, or to a player/mob by name.

long: Costs 7 stamina, deals damage scaled by your skill and blinds the target for one tick (one MUD hour, about 75 seconds), cutting their accuracy. Default target is your current Fighting target. Cure Blind or Heal restores their sight.
name: gouge
summary: Eye gouge — damage plus a temporary blind effect.

long: Coder+. Per-character command access. A grant lets a character use one command above their rank; a revoke takes a command away. Only online players strictly below your level, and only commands you can use yourself. 'grant <name>' lists a character's grants and revokes; 'grant <name> clear' drops the ones at or below your level. A mortal can only be granted commands on the grants.mortal_allowlist config row (empty by default), and never an admin command. Command groups and privilege flags do not exist on this server.
name: grant
summary: Let a character use a command above their rank.

long: Sends a one-line vitals snapshot to every member of your current group regardless of room. Used to coordinate healing / retreat without reading raw 'who' numbers.
name: greport
summary: Broadcast your hp/stamina to your group.

long: Picks one open exit at random; every group member in your current room moves through it and drops their Fighting state. Refused if you're not grouped or if the room has no open exits.
name: gretreat
summary: Coordinated group retreat — every group member in your room flees together.

long: Shows the group leader and every member, with HP and same-room indicator. Joining a group takes the leader's 'invite' and your 'accept'; merely following someone does not put you in their group.
name: group
summary: List your current group.

long: Reaches every member of your current group regardless of room. Players outside the group never see it. Refused when you're not grouped.
name: gsay
summary: Speak privately to your group.

long: Sets a 'Guarding' link from you onto the named player; while you're in the same room, attackers targeting them swing at you instead. 'guard off' clears the link. 'guard' with no arg reports the current target.
name: guard
summary: Stand bodyguard — intercept incoming swings on a target.

long: With no arguments, shows commands available to you grouped by category. With an argument, shows the usage and details for that command. Admin commands live in 'wizhelp' (Builder+ only). Try 'help newbie' for a starter-pack of practical first goals.
name: help
summary: List commands or show details on a specific one.

long: Builder+. Looks up the target's PlayerHouse, synthesizes the ECS Room entities for it (if not yet cached in HousingIndex), then warps you to the foyer ('local_index = 0'). Works for offline owners — reads the snapshot straight from the DB. Routed through the async dispatcher; the sync stub only fires on dispatcher misconfig.
name: hgoto
summary: Teleport into the named player's house foyer.

long: Builder+. Creates a 'PlayerHouse' row for the named character with the entrance set to the room you're currently standing in. Seeds one foyer room ('local_index = 0'). Fails if the character already owns a house — use 'hrevoke' first.
name: hgrant
summary: Assign a fresh house to a player.

long: Rolls how well you hide from your hide skill, Dexterity and Intelligence (rogues and DEX help most). Anyone whose perception is below that number cannot see you until you act: any command but looking around, hiding, moving and the like gives you away, as does attacking or being found by 'search'. Walking wears the hiding down; 'sneak' slows that. Hiding leaves you busy for a combat round (half for thieves). Your group always sees you.
name: hide
summary: Slip into the shadows.

long: Builder+. Loads the named player's PlayerHouse row plus rooms / item count / guest list and prints the summary. Doesn't require the target to be online.
name: hinfo
summary: Inspect any player's house from anywhere.

long: Spawns a fresh mob as your follower. Coin from 'wealth'. Pet is renamed to '<you>'s <mob>' so it doesn't blend with wild mobs of the same kind.
name: hire
summary: Hire a pet from a pet-shop keeper.

long: Costs 10 stamina. Damages each Mob in the room for half your damage. Mobs with no Health (test dummy) are skipped. The first surviving mob becomes your Fighting target if you weren't already fighting. Players are never targeted.
name: hitall
summary: One swing at every hostile mob in your room.

long: Equips an item in the Hold slot (lights, instruments, wands). Refused on items that don't go in Hold.
name: hold
summary: Hold a non-weapon item in your offhand.

long: Sets HOLY_LIGHT. Renderer plumbing for invisibility and darkness is pending; the flag persists so it's live the moment those land.
name: holylight
summary: Toggle holy-light vision (admin/builder).

long: Players who own a house can inspect its layout, guest list, room contents, or step inside via 'house enter'. 'house' (no arg) defaults to the info subcommand. Players without a house get a polite refusal — house creation isn't yet wired through the runtime.
name: house
summary: Inspect or enter your player house.

long: Implementor-only. Deletes the named character's PlayerHouse row; FK cascades remove all rooms, exits, placed items, and guest entries. The owner's in-memory 'HouseSummary' component remains until they reconnect — bounce them if they're online.
name: hrevoke
summary: Delete a player's house and all its rooms / items.

long: Same as 'bug' but tagged Idea. Same 'Reports' row shape; 'report list <kind>' filters.
name: idea
summary: Suggest a feature / change to the staff.

long: Reveals the item's type, weight, base value, wear slots, weapon dice (when applicable), bound abilities (scrolls/wands/staves), liquid state (drink containers), remaining charges, and any active effects on the item.
name: identify
summary: Magical analysis of a carried item.

long: Same population as 'who', but ordered by how long since each player last typed something. Players who just connected and haven't typed yet show as 'fresh'; anyone under a minute shows as 'active'. With a numeric arg, filters to players idle that many minutes or more — handy for spotting AFK staff or stuck sessions.
name: idle
summary: Show online players sorted by idle time, longest first.

long: Edits the specific item you carry, wear or see in the room; the prototype is untouched. 'iedit <item>' shows the editable fields. 'iedit <item> name <text>' sets the short description, 'examine <text>' the examine text, 'keywords <w1 w2 ...>' the keyword list, 'charges <n>' (-1 = unlimited). 'clear' on name/examine/keywords restores the prototype's. Colour tags are allowed. Changes apply at once and save with the holder.
name: iedit
summary: Edit one item instance online (Builder+).

long: No arg: list current entries. '<name>': add. '-<name>': remove. 'clear': drop the whole list. Per-session today; persistence is a follow-up.
name: ignore
summary: Block tells / channel msgs from a player.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: in
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Coder+ (level 104+) only. Adds <hours> to 'MudClock.hour' modulo 24 — useful for testing day/night triggers and dawn/dusk weather transitions without waiting for real time.
name: inctime
summary: Force-advance the in-game clock.

long: Without arguments, reads the 'RaceAbilities' rows for your character's race and prints each ability's name, category (PRIMARY / SECONDARY / ...), starting bonus, and proficiency cap. 'innate <ability> [target]' uses one of the active ones, exactly as if you had typed its own command (cast, breathe, ...); only abilities your race grants can be used this way.
name: innate
summary: List or use your race's innate abilities.

long: Legacy shop service. With no argument, lists the keeper's wares with their inspection fee (a tenth of the purchase price, minimum one copper). With an item number or name, pays the fee and shows that item's full stat block without buying it; a pet number or name shows the pet's stats. Staff inspect for free.
name: inspect
summary: Pay a shopkeeper to identify a wares item or pet.

long: Picks a random insult and emits it to you, the target, and the rest of the room. Self-targeting leaves you feeling insulted at yourself.
name: insult
summary: Hurl a random insult at someone in the room.

long: Shows everything in your inventory by name. Use 'get' to pick items up and 'drop' to set them down. With a filter arg, only items whose name contains the substring (case-insensitive) are shown — useful for pruning a packed bag down to e.g. just potions.
name: inventory
summary: List items you are carrying.

long: Target gets a pending 'GroupInvite'; they can 'accept' or 'decline'. Invites expire after 5 minutes. Players already following you (in your group) can't be re-invited.
name: invite
summary: Send a group invite to another player.

long: The item is despawned; nothing is dropped on the floor and no coin is awarded. Refuses on equipped gear — 'remove' first.
name: junk
summary: Permanently destroy a carried item.

long: Extra attack outside the normal combat-tick rhythm. Rolls weapon damage scaled by attack_power, then adds +4. With no name it hits your current target; with one it picks that fight.
name: kick
summary: Kick your target, or the one you name (which starts a fight).

long: For mortals, identical to attack. Staff characters of level 101 and above (legacy LVL_GOD) slay a non-player target on the spot, with no kill credit, instead of entering combat.
name: kill
summary: Engage a target in melee combat (staff slay it outright).

long: Changes your posture to kneeling. Ranks the same as sitting for ability gating, but regenerates like standing — useful for guards, prayer, or showing respect.
name: kneel
summary: Kneel — lower-profile but still alert.

long: Builder+. Looks up the character row by name and prints the last 'last_login' timestamp, level, race / class, and online-now status. Async DB call — output is delivered after the lookup returns.
name: last
summary: Show last-login info for a character.

long: Shows the last <n> gossip utterances (default 10, capped at 50). In-memory only — clears on server restart, like the legacy ring buffer.
name: lastgossips
summary: Replay recent gossip channel lines.

long: Shows the last <n> shouts (default 10, capped at 50).
name: lastshouts
summary: Replay recent shout channel lines.

long: Reads 'TellLog', hydrated at login from the 'tell_message' table. Each row shows the sender and how long ago the tell arrived.
name: lasttells
summary: Show your bounded recent-tells history.

long: Heals 30 HP at a cost of 12 stamina. Works while fighting (unlike 'bandage'). Refused on full-HP targets. Default target is yourself.
name: layhands
summary: Holy heal — bigger than bandage, works in combat.

long: Inverse of 'enter' for vehicles. Today the only in-vehicle state we model is mounted, so 'leave' is a synonym for 'dismount'. When boats / carriages land it'll cover those too.
name: leave
summary: Exit your current vehicle / mount.

long: Shows your level, a progress bar and how much XP is left to the next level, scaled for your class. At the mortal cap with enough XP to reach level 100 you are marked with your class stars ('**') instead.
name: level
summary: Your level and progress toward the next one.

long: Prints the experience your class needs to reach each level, and marks the level you are on. Use 'level' to see your own progress toward the next one.
name: levels
summary: Show the experience needed for every level.

long: Lights a Light-type item you are carrying, holding or wearing. Wearing or holding a light does not light it. Refused on non-light items, items that are already lit, and burnt-out lights. Permanent lights are always lit.
name: light
summary: Light a torch or lantern.

long: Looks for a 'Shopkeeper'-tagged mob in your room, then prints the keeper's catalog with prices and stock. 'buy <#|name>' and 'sell <item>' land next.
name: list
summary: Show what the shopkeeper here is selling.

long: Builder+. Same as 'summon' for count=1, kept as a separate verb for muscle-memory.
name: load
summary: Spawn a mob proto into your current room.

long: Builder+. Materializes one instance of (zone, id) from 'ObjectPrototypes' Located on your current room.
name: loadobj
summary: Spawn an object proto onto the floor.

long: Mirror of 'unlock': requires the exit to be closed (not already locked, not open) and to have a key requirement, and that you carry that key. On match, the door is locked.
name: lock
summary: Lock a closed door using a key in your inventory.

long: Shows the current room's name, anyone or anything else present, and the available exits.
name: look
summary: Look at your surroundings.

long: Runs 'code' with 'actor' bound to your character. Same Lua API surface as triggers.
name: lua
summary: Run a snippet of Lua code.

long: Drains 4 stamina and dispatches the LURE skill at the named target. Effect is a level-scaling physical-damage application; combat starts via the normal damage→engage path. Same arg-resolution as 'backstab'.
name: lure
summary: Bait a mob into engaging you with a stinging hit.

long: Opens a multi-line composition session: first non-blank line is the subject, subsequent lines accumulate as body. Control verbs: '.send' ships the draft, '.abort' discards it, '.preview' shows what's queued, '.clear' wipes the draft.
name: mail
summary: Open a mail composition session to one player.

long: Newest first; unread messages have a '*' prefix. Use 'readmail <#>' to read by slot — that also marks the row read.
name: mailbox
summary: List inbound mail in your account inbox.

long: Doubles the rate at which 'memorize' slots refill. Requires resting / sitting / kneeling — standing or sleeping breaks focus, as does taking a step or being attacked. Re-running 'meditate' ends the trance.
name: meditate
summary: Focus to speed up spell memorization.

long: FieryMUD uses a slot-pool model, not a Vance-style prepared-spell list. There's nothing to memorize ahead of time: at each level you have a fixed number of slots per circle (see 'slots' for your current capacity), and any spell you've trained ('study <spell>') can be cast while a slot of its circle is free. This command redirects to 'slots'.
name: memorize
summary: (legacy alias) Show your spell-slot pool.

long: Builder+. Lists mob prototypes from the loaded catalog as '[zone:id] name', sorted by (zone, id). With no argument it lists your current zone; '*' lists every zone; '<zone>' lists that zone; '<zone> <first> <last>' (or '<zone>:<first> <zone>:<last>') narrows to an id span, and a missing <last> means 'to the end of the zone'. Long lists are paged 50 rows at a time: add 'page <n>'. Pair with 'mstat <zone> <id>' for a prototype's detail, or 'msearch' to search by name.
name: mlist
summary: List mob prototypes in a zone or id range.

long: Builder+. Lists prototypes whose name or keywords start with every word you give, as 'zone:id name', sorted by id and capped at 100 rows. 'vnum' takes a type first (mobiles, objects, rooms, triggers, exits), 'mnum' / 'onum' / 'rnum' / 'tnum' are the same search for one type. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone. Pair with 'vstat', 'rstat' or 'tstat', or jump with 'goto <zone>:<id>'.
name: mnum
summary: Find mob prototypes by keyword (zone:id).

long: Builder+. Reads the mob proto and 'TriggerCatalog' attachments, then summarises in plain English: alignment-driven aggression, behaviors (sentinel, wimpy, etc.), and whether the mob is scripted. For the raw fields use 'mstat'; this is the form you want when explaining a mob to a designer.
name: mob-ai
summary: Plain-English brief of a mob's behavior.

long: Static welcome text for now — once a GameConfig 'motd' row lands, this will read from there.
name: motd
summary: Show the message-of-the-day.

long: Target must be 'Mountable' (auto-applied to mobs whose keywords contain horse / steed / mount / donkey / mare). When you move, your mount comes with you. Refused on already-mounted you, on already-ridden mounts, or on mobs in combat.
name: mount
summary: Climb onto a mountable mob.

long: Builder+. 'msearch <field> <query> [in <zone>]' searches mob prototypes (legacy 'msearch'; same as 'vsearch mobiles'). Fields: name, short, long, desc, race, gender, role, level, alignment, flags (sentinel, wimpy, shopkeeper, aquatic, ...), effflags (permanent effects), size, lifeforce. Examples: 'msearch flags sentinel wimpy', 'msearch level 30..40 in 12', 'msearch race dragon', 'msearch lifeforce undead'. Numbers take 5, >5, <5, >=5, <=5, !5, 5..9 or the legacy 'gt 5' / 'bt 5 9'. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone; at most 100 rows print.
name: msearch
summary: Search mob prototypes by name, flags, level, race, size, ...

long:
Builder+. Reads 'MobPrototypes' and prints the proto fields + linked behaviors / professions / abilities / triggers. Three target forms:
  mstat <zone> <id>   composite key
  mstat <id>          id in your current zone
  mstat <name>        substring against proto name

For a LIVE mob's per-instance state, use 'stat <name>' — stat reads every component on a live entity, mstat reads the static catalog row that produced it.
name: mstat
summary: Dump a mob PROTOTYPE (template, not a live mob).

long: RP-flavored counterpart to 'gossip'. Same Deaf / ignore filtering. Convention: in-character song lyrics or melodic flavor.
name: music
summary: Sing on the global music channel.

long: Builder+. Toggles 'PlayerFlag::Muted' on the target. Muted players can't use gossip / shout / music / clan / quest channels — 'say' and 'tell' are unaffected so they can still play. Re-running 'mute <name>' clears it.
name: mute
summary: Toggle a player's silence on global channels.

long: Reports the live name-approval gate state. Useful when chat channels refuse and you want to confirm that the gate (not an effect / freeze / ignore-list) is the cause. No-op besides the readout.
name: name_status
summary: Check whether your character name is staff-approved.

long: Labels an item you carry or wear, e.g. 'nameitem sack gems' turns "a cloth sack" into "a cloth sack (labeled 'gems')". The item keeps its own name; the label's words also work for targeting ('get ruby gems'). Labels are 3-40 characters; colour codes and unusual symbols are removed. 'nameitem sack clear' removes the label. Works on any item. Carried items are matched before worn ones.
name: nameitem
summary: Add a label of your own to an item you carry.

long: Lists the practical next steps for a new character: get oriented, equip gear, find a trainer, fight a safe mob, and recall back. Re-run any time you forget where you were — it's not state-dependent.
name: newbie
summary: Show a short starter-pack of first goals.

long: Static for now; will read from a future news table.
name: news
summary: Recent server news.

long: Toggles NO_REPEAT. While on, say, tell, reply, whisper, ask, gsay and the global channels answer you with just "Ok." instead of repeating what you typed. Others see your message as usual.
name: norepeat
summary: Don't echo your own say/tell/channel text back.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: north
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: northeast
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: northwest
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: By default, when someone casts SUMMON on you, you get a 30-second 'accept' / 'decline' prompt. Setting NO_SUMMON short-circuits that — incoming summons are silently refused without prompting you, and the caster sees "X is not accepting summons." Use this when you want to AFK without summon-prompt interruptions. Run again to re-enable the prompt. PK-flagged players (see 'pk') bypass the prompt entirely — that's part of opting into PvP.
name: nosummon
summary: Silently auto-decline incoming summon spells.

long: When set, other players' 'tell' to you is blocked with a message. Run again to allow tells.
name: notell
summary: Refuse incoming 'tell' messages.

long: Speak to a receptionist (or stand in an inn) to hear the terms. Your character and belongings are saved automatically and cost nothing to keep: 'quit' anywhere (or 'rent' at a receptionist) to save and leave. Inns additionally sell prepaid rest tiers; 'offer' lists them, 'rent <name>' books one.
name: offer
summary: Ask a receptionist what it costs to store your belongings.

long: Builder+. Lists object prototypes from the loaded catalog as '[zone:id] name', sorted by (zone, id). With no argument it lists your current zone; '*' lists every zone; '<zone>' lists that zone; '<zone> <first> <last>' (or '<zone>:<first> <zone>:<last>') narrows to an id span, and a missing <last> means 'to the end of the zone'. Long lists are paged 50 rows at a time: add 'page <n>'. Pair with 'ostat <zone> <id>' for a prototype's detail, or 'osearch' to search by name.
name: olist
summary: List object prototypes in a zone or id range.

long: Builder+. Lists prototypes whose name or keywords start with every word you give, as 'zone:id name', sorted by id and capped at 100 rows. 'vnum' takes a type first (mobiles, objects, rooms, triggers, exits), 'mnum' / 'onum' / 'rnum' / 'tnum' are the same search for one type. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone. Pair with 'vstat', 'rstat' or 'tstat', or jump with 'goto <zone>:<id>'.
name: onum
summary: Find object prototypes by keyword (zone:id).

long: Refused if the exit is already open or locked. Locked doors need a key (use 'unlock').
name: open
summary: Open a closed door in the given direction.

long: Forwards '<command>' to a named mob follower (must be in the same room and have 'Follower(you)' set), or 'all' for every same-room follower at once. The mob runs the command through the normal dispatcher under its own identity, so target lookups, costs, and triggers fire as if it had typed the line. Admin commands are off-limits to mobs.
name: order
summary: Issue a command to one or all of your followers.

long: Builder+. 'osearch <field> <query> [in <zone>]' searches object prototypes (legacy 'osearch'; same as 'vsearch objects'). Fields: name, short, long, desc, type, wear, extraflags (glow, magic, nodrop, ...), effflags (effects the item grants, e.g. sanctuary), level, weight, cost, timer. Examples: 'osearch type weapon', 'osearch wear head neck', 'osearch effflags sanctuary in 30', 'osearch level 20..30', 'osearch cost gt 5000'. Numbers take 5, >5, <5, >=5, <=5, !5, 5..9 or the legacy 'gt 5' / 'bt 5 9'. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone; at most 100 rows print.
name: osearch
summary: Search object prototypes by name, type, wear or effect flags, level, ...

long: Builder+. Mirrors 'mstat' for objects: type, weight, wear flags, locks (!DROP / CURSED!!), armor, stat bonuses, effect flags, special-values per type. 'stat <object>' prints the same block for a live item. Same target forms — composite key, id in current zone, or substring against proto name.
name: ostat
summary: Dump an object PROTOTYPE.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: out
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Builder+. Sends '*<you>* <message>' with two terminal bells to one player anywhere in the game. 'page all' reaches everyone and needs a level above 101.
name: page
summary: Beep a player with a message.

long: Builder+. Emits a roleplay-flavor pain line — no actual HP / stamina change. The target sees a personalized line; the room sees a third-person broadcast. Use to express divine displeasure during live events.
name: pain
summary: Cosmetic divine wrath flourish on a single player.

long: Rogue skill. Conceals an item from your inventory from casual detection for a while; others may spot it with perception. Uses the PALM ability's proficiency and effect from the database.
name: palm
summary: Secretly hide a small item in your hand.

long: Builder+. Removes the 'Fighting' component from every entity in your room — useful when a brawl gets out of hand or a Lua trigger spawned a hostile mob you'd rather not pile on. Each disengaged combatant gets a quiet "calm settles over the room" line; a room broadcast confirms the action.
name: peace
summary: Stop all combat in your current room.

long: Race-gated to Avariel. Piercing strike — engages combat if not already fighting the target. Damage scales with level.
name: peck
summary: Drive your beak into a target (Avariel only).

long: Same shape as 'cast' but filters to abilityType = SONG. Stub: prints metadata and gates on KnownAbilities, no effect application yet.
name: perform
summary: Perform a song from the catalog (bard).

long: From a mortal: broadcasts the petition to every online Immortal+. From an immortal: if the first arg matches an online player name, reply to that player privately (the legacy 'ptell' form folded in). Mortals never see anyone else's petitions.
name: petition
summary: Send to immortals — or, as immortal, reply privately.

long: Shows your pets, hirelings and charmed creatures, where each one is, and how healthy it looks. Use 'call' to bring them to you.
name: pets
summary: List the creatures following you.

long: Skill check against your 'PICK_LOCK' proficiency. Refuses on unlocked exits, exits without a keyhole, and players who haven't trained pick lock. Costs 5 stamina whether you succeed or fail. On success the door flips Locked → Closed (same as 'unlock'); on failure you get a fumble line.
name: pick
summary: Pick a locked door open with rogue tools.

long: Sets PK_ENABLED. Two players can fight each other only while BOTH have PK on. Turning it on works anywhere; you can turn it off only at your recall point, and not while fighting another player.
name: pk
summary: Toggle player-kill participation.

long: Plays a held instrument; magical instruments invoke their bound abilities and spend a charge when they land.
name: play
summary: Play an instrument you are holding.

long: Builder+. Without args after the name, prints the current staff notes. With text, appends a new line prefixed with the timestamp and your character name. 'clear' is Implementor-only and wipes the entire log.
name: pnote
summary: Read / append / clear staff notes on a character.

long: Resolves <target> against (in order): a direction (n/s/e/w/u/d), an actor in your room (player or mob), or an item in your room or inventory. Pointing at a hidden actor reveals them — stealth doesn't survive being singled out.
name: point
summary: Point at someone, something, or a direction.

long: Static for now. Aliases: 'rules', 'policy'.
name: policies
summary: Server rules and code of conduct.

long: Builder+. Replaces the generic "$n appears with an ear-splitting bang." with your own line ('$n' stands for your name). Bare 'poofin' shows the current value; 'poofin clear' removes it.
name: poofin
summary: Set your custom arrival message on goto / teleport.

long: Builder+. Mirrors 'poofin'. Replaces the generic "$n disappears in a puff of smoke." departure line.
name: poofout
summary: Set your custom departure message on goto / teleport.

long: Opens a multi-line composition session: first non-blank line is the subject, subsequent lines accumulate as body. '.send' ships, '.abort' cancels, '.preview' shows the draft. Locked boards refuse the open.
name: post
summary: Compose a new message on a board.

long: With no target, dumps the source's liquid on the ground. With a target container, transfers as much as the target can accept; refuses on liquid-type mismatch unless the target is empty (in which case the target adopts the source's liquid + poison flag).
name: pour
summary: Transfer liquid between containers, or empty.

long: Without an argument, renders KnownAbilities with proficiency 0-1000 and a tier label. With an ability name, raises that ability's proficiency by 5 (capped at the class's 'proficiency_cap' from 'ClassAbilities'). Persists across reconnect via 'CharacterAbilities'.
name: practice
summary: List trained abilities, or improve proficiency.

long: With no argument, prints your current template. With a template, replaces it. Variables: %h current HP, %H max HP, %v current stamina, %V max stamina, %n your name, %r current room, %g on-hand wealth (copper), %t in-game hour (zero-padded), %s season, %d day/night, %% literal percent. Examples: prompt <%h/%H hp %v/%V st> prompt [%t %h/%H %d]
name: prompt
summary: Show or change your status prompt template.

long: Builder+. Joins 'CharacterItems' × 'Characters' × 'Objects' against an item-name substring and prints one row per (player, item) hit. Async DB query — covers offline characters, not just online ones. Capped at 200 hits server-side.
name: pscan
summary: Scan every persisted character's inventory for an item.

long: Immortal+. Sends <message> privately to the petitioner and shows the other online immortals who answered whom. Refused for staff targets (use wiznet) and for a player who is writing a message.
name: ptell
summary: Answer a player's petition.

long: HeadBuilder+ (level 103+) only. With no arg, removes every mob / item in your current room. With a name, despawns that one entity.
name: purge
summary: Despawn the named target — or every non-player in the room.

long: Container can be a carried item or one in the current room. Equipped items must be 'remove'd first. Bystanders see the action.
name: put
summary: Move a carried item into a container.

long: Self-service quest acceptance. Validates level range, checks every required prerequisite, and refuses if you already have it in progress (or completed it once already on a non-repeatable quest).
name: qaccept
summary: Accept a quest by composite id.

long: Slot number from the 'quests' in-progress section. Flips IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED, stamps completed_at and bumps completion_count. Coder rank and above also get the quest's unconditional rewards exactly as a real completion pays them (conditional and choice rewards stay behind 'qreward'); lower ranks complete it without rewards. Objectives and phases are not run. Audited.
name: qcomplete
summary: Admin: force-complete an in-progress quest (coder+ pays rewards).

long: Builder+. Drops a flavor announcement onto the quest channel without quoting the speaker (e.g. "<msg>" rather than "X qsays, '<msg>'"). Useful for run-of-show quest narration.
name: qecho
summary: Admin echo to the quest channel.

long: Same as 'qload' but targets a named online player instead of the caller. Target must be currently online (offline-character assignment is left for a future iteration).
name: qgive
summary: Admin: assign a quest to another online player.

long: Inserts a CharacterQuest row with status IN_PROGRESS for the caller's character. No-op if that quest is already assigned to you.
name: qload
summary: Admin: assign a quest to your character (testing).

long: Deletes the character's whole record of the quest: status, objective progress and quest variables, so it can be given or accepted from scratch ('qload', 'qgive' and 'qaccept' refuse while any record exists). Builders may reset their own character only; coder rank and above may reset anyone, including offline characters. Rewards already paid are not taken back. 'zone:id' is accepted in place of '<zone> <quest-id>'. Audited.
name: qreset
summary: Admin: wipe a player's record of a quest.

long: With no arguments, lists every choice-reward group from your completed quests that you haven't claimed yet. With <zone> <quest-id>, lists choices for that quest. With all three args, claims the named reward (id from the listing). One pick per choice_group.
name: qreward
summary: List or claim a choice-group reward.

long: Visible to every online player not Deaf and not ignoring you. Conventionally used to coordinate quest progress with other questers. Same shape as 'gossip' — separate channel mostly for ear cleanliness.
name: qsay
summary: Talk on the quest channel.

long: Despawns the potion. Refused on non-potion items. Effect application (ConsumableEffects) is deferred.
name: quaff
summary: Drink a potion from your inventory.

long: Toggles your QUEST flag, which marks you as taking part in staff-run quest events ('quest on' / 'quest off' set it explicitly). Use 'quests' to see your own quests.
name: quest
summary: Join or leave the Quest event.

long: Reads the 'Quest' row for '(zone, id)' and prints name, level range, flags (repeatable / shareable / hidden / auto-accept), short description, and full description.
name: questinfo
summary: Show details for a single quest definition.

long: In-progress quests appear first with their short description; completed/abandoned quests follow with their final status. Each in-progress quest also shows its phases + objective progress (▶ for current, ✓ for done, [N/M] for showProgress). Immortal+ may add a player's name (online or offline) to see that player's quests, including each quest's stored quest variables. A player hidden from you by wizinvis cannot be looked up.
name: quests
summary: List your accepted quests (staff: or a player's).

long: Saves your character, says goodbye and drops the connection. You can't quit while fighting (staff excepted) or while casting. The whole word is required; 'q', 'qu' and 'qui' only remind you of that.
name: quit
summary: Save your character and leave the game.

long: Finds an item by keyword on you or in the room and prints its description text. Refuses on mobs and players — use 'examine' for those.
name: read
summary: Read the text on an item (book, sign, scroll).

long: Slot number is the '#' from 'mailbox'. Marks the row read on first read; subsequent re-reads are silent.
name: readmail
summary: Read a single mail message by slot.

long: Move instantly to your saved recall room. If you haven't bound one yet you go to your race's start room — 'touch <touchstone>' in a sanctuary room to bind your recall there. Builders can use 'setrecall' from any room.
name: recall
summary: Teleport to your recall point.

long: Looks up the bound abilities via ObjectAbilities and dispatches each through the cast pipeline. Despawns the scroll regardless of outcome (single-use).
name: recite
summary: Read a magic scroll, casting its inscribed spells.

long: Immortal+. Only for a character whose name is awaiting approval; an approved character is refused. Renames the named character to the staff-chosen replacement and flips name_approved to true (the new name is by definition staff-approved). Refuses while the target is online — the in-memory Named cache needs a fresh login to pick up the rename cleanly. A duplicate new-name surfaces as the Postgres unique-index error.
name: reject_name
summary: Force-rename a pending character and approve.

long: When you die, your spirit is left where you fell while your corpse drops at the death scene. 'release' returns you to your recall point at full HP. Refused when you aren't currently dead.
name: release
summary: End the ghost cycle: restore HP, return to recall.

long: Coder+. Same as 'reloadzone' applied to every zone: rooms, prototypes and resets are re-read from the database; live instances are untouched.
name: reloadallzones
summary: Reload every zone's world data from the DB.

long: Builder+. Re-reads the zone's room definitions (name, description, flags, exits, extra descriptions), the mob/object prototypes it owns, and its reset rows from the database, so edits made in the editor take effect without a restart. Live mobs and items are left alone; new prototypes apply to future spawns. Defaults to your current zone. Exit door states of reloaded rooms reset to their authored default; rooms deleted from the DB stay until restart.
name: reloadzone
summary: Reload one zone's rooms, mobs, objects and resets from the DB.

long: The item must currently be equipped on you.
name: remove
summary: Unequip an item, returning it to your inventory.

long: Implementor-only. Refuses while the target is online — the in-memory Named cache and the ConnRouter mappings would drift otherwise. The character_id is the FK across CharacterItems / CharacterAbilities / etc., so foreign-key relationships survive untouched. Conflicts on the new name surface as the unique-index error from Postgres.
name: rename
summary: Rename a character (offline-only).

long: Costs 7 stamina, deals weapon damage, applies a 'bleed' EffectInstance for 30s. Default target is the current Fighting target. Refused if the target is already bleeding.
name: rend
summary: Tearing attack — damage plus bleed effect.

long: With a receptionist present, plain 'rent' stores your belongings and leaves the game exactly like 'quit', keeping any rest you have already booked. 'offer' lists the available inn tiers and their prices (so does 'rent' in an inn with no receptionist). 'rent <name>' books that tier and charges the fee in gold and queues an INN RestSource at the chosen tier; you'll see Refreshed regen and any Wake Effect attachments on your next XP gain after logging back in. Tiers 2 and 3 prompt for confirmation; reply 'y' to confirm or 'n' to abort. Fee is flat — pay once, return whenever.
name: rent
summary: Rent a room: save and leave at a receptionist, or book an inn rest.

long: Refills a lantern or torch for 10 copper per missing game-hour of fuel. Other items have no durability and are reported as already in perfect condition.
name: repair
summary: Have a shopkeeper repair or refuel an item.

long: Forwards through 'tell' so the LastTeller stamp lands on them too — start a back-and-forth without typing the name.
name: reply
summary: Send a tell to whoever last told you.

long: With no argument, says your hit and movement points to everyone in the room. 'report <player>' tells that player instead (only they see it, and the usual tell refusals apply). Use 'greport' to report to your whole group.
name: report
summary: Announce your HP/stamina to the room or one player.

long: Builder+ (level 101+) only. Wipes CoreStats and rolls 3d6 per axis (STR / DEX / CON / INT / WIS / CHA). Sends the new roll to the target so they can verify it.
name: reroll
summary: Reroll a player's six core stats (3d6 each).

long: Find <player> in your room. Their attacker now targets you instead and you target them. The ally is freed from combat. Costs 6 stamina. Refused if you're already fighting and refused if your ally isn't being attacked.
name: rescue
summary: Take an enemy's aggression onto yourself.

long: Changes your posture to resting. Posture sets how fast you recover: standing restores stamina only, sitting a little hit points as well, resting more, and sleeping the most.
name: rest
summary: Rest in place.

long: HeadBuilder+ (level 103+) only. No-op for offline players.
name: restore
summary: Refill a player's HP and stamina to max.

long: Like 'flee' but you choose where to go. Refused if the direction has no exit, the door's closed, or the target room is dangling.
name: retreat
summary: Flee combat in a specific direction.

long: Builder+. Inverse of 'switch'. Always types as the puppeteer (not the mob) — the dispatcher keeps 'return' and 'switch' as escape hatches so a stuck switch can always be undone.
name: return
summary: End a 'switch' session and return to your own body.

long: Coder+. Per-character command access. A grant lets a character use one command above their rank; a revoke takes a command away. Only online players strictly below your level, and only commands you can use yourself. 'grant <name>' lists a character's grants and revokes; 'grant <name> clear' drops the ones at or below your level. A mortal can only be granted commands on the grants.mortal_allowlist config row (empty by default), and never an admin command. Command groups and privilege flags do not exist on this server.
name: revoke
summary: Take a command away from a character.

long: Prints a sampler of every color and modifier the XML-Lite renderer supports — handy for verifying your client's color depth and for debugging color-tag rendering.
name: richtest
summary: Render a color-tag sampler.

long: Builder+. Lists loaded rooms as '[zone:id] name', sorted by (zone, id). With no argument it lists your current zone; '*' lists every zone; '<zone>' lists that zone; '<zone> <first> <last>' (or '<zone>:<first> <zone>:<last>') narrows to an id span, and a missing <last> means 'to the end of the zone'. Long lists are paged 50 rows at a time: add 'page <n>'. Pair with 'rstat' for a room's detail, or 'rsearch' to search by name.
name: rlist
summary: List rooms in a zone or id range.

long: Builder+. Lists prototypes whose name or keywords start with every word you give, as 'zone:id name', sorted by id and capped at 100 rows. 'vnum' takes a type first (mobiles, objects, rooms, triggers, exits), 'mnum' / 'onum' / 'rnum' / 'tnum' are the same search for one type. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone. Pair with 'vstat', 'rstat' or 'tstat', or jump with 'goto <zone>:<id>'.
name: rnum
summary: Find rooms by name keyword (zone:id).

long: Costs 8 stamina. Also deals the Roar skill's damage to each enemy in the room. Each enemy that fails its saving throw panics: it flees, trips over its own feet, or (if asleep) may be jolted awake. Aware and no-summon mobs, and mobs immune to fear, ignore it. Group members are not affected.
name: roar
summary: Terrify everyone in the room into running.

long: Diagnostic: prints the role and any extra permissions attached to your account.
name: roles
summary: Show your account role and permissions.

long: Costs 7 stamina. Heavier kick than the basic 'kick' skill (which adds +4); pure damage multiplier. Requires you to be fighting someone.
name: roundhouse
summary: Powerful kick — 1.5x damage on your current target.
