long: HeadBuilder+ (level 103+) only. Same as 'pain' but reaches every online player. Pure flavor — no stat change. Optional <message> overrides the default line. Players see your line; the caster sees a confirmation count.
name: rpain
summary: Cosmetic divine pain across the realm.

long: Immortal+ (level 100+) only. Restores HP / stamina to max and clears every active EffectInstance for every online player. Optional <message> overrides the default flavor line. The realm-wide counterpart to 'restore'.
name: rrestore
summary: Heal every online player + strip every effect.

long: Builder+. 'rsearch <field> <query> [in <zone>]' searches rooms (legacy 'rsearch'; same as 'vsearch rooms'). Fields: name, desc, sector (city, forest, water, ...), flags (peaceful, nomagic, norecall, nosummon, noteleport, deathtrap, indoors, soundproof, arena, guildhall, nomobs, notracking, noportals, noscanning, inn). Examples: 'rsearch flags deathtrap', 'rsearch sector forest in 30', 'rsearch flags nomagic peaceful'. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone; at most 100 rows print.
name: rsearch
summary: Search rooms by name, description, sector or room flags.

long: Builder+. With no arg, inspects your current room. <id> alone looks up the room in your current zone. Composite <zone> <id> works too.
name: rstat
summary: Dump a room's ECS state (live entity, not catalog).

long: Persists hp / stamina / xp / inventory / location / flags / prompt / hunger / thirst / drunk / known abilities / spell-slot cooldowns / ability cooldowns back to the schema. The same path runs automatically on disconnect and on graceful shutdown — 'save' lets you force it right now without logging out, useful before a risky encounter or when the network feels unstable.
name: save
summary: Force a checkpoint of your character to the database.

long: Builder+. The C++ server wrote zone files to disk. Here the database is the source of truth and the editor writes it, so there is nothing to save; use 'reloadzone' to pull editor changes into the world.
name: savezone
summary: No-op: world data is saved by the editor.

long: Visible to every player in your current room. Triggers SPEECH-flagged Lua bodies on mobs / objects in the room.
name: say
summary: Speak to everyone in the room.

long: Walks each unblocked exit and lists every mob / player you'd see in those rooms, with a distance label and posture (std/sit/fly/slp). Default range is one room; staff scan up to three. Closed or hidden doors stop the walk in that direction. Useful for spotting threats / hosts before walking in.
name: scan
summary: Peek at the adjacent rooms one step away.

long: Shows HP, stamina, six core attributes, the modern combat triple (Acc / Eva / Atk / Armor%), alignment, posture, location, recall point, and your current combat target when fighting. Spell-circle slots are surfaced separately via 'slots'; full effect durations via 'effects'; XP / next-level gains via 'level'.
name: score
summary: Display your character's stats.

long: You must be sitting, out of combat, carrying a scroll, and know the spell at 50% proficiency or better.
name: scribe
summary: Scribe a known spell onto a blank scroll.

long: Builder+. Prints the in-memory 'ScriptErrorLog' ring (most-recent first). Default 'n=20'.
name: scripterrors
summary: Show recent trigger fire failures.

long: Refuses while fighting. Hidden objects come first: 'search' checks the ones lying in the room, 'search <container>' the ones inside it. Your perception cuts each one's hiding by a random amount, and whatever is left within your perception is found (staff find them all); finding something ends the search. Otherwise each hidden exit you haven't found is checked in turn: naming its keyword ('search monolith') always finds it, otherwise your Intelligence is rolled against 0-200. The first exit found is revealed (staff always find one). A search leaves you busy for half a combat round. Reveals are per-character and session-scoped — a fresh login starts back at zero known hidden exits, matching the legacy contract until a persistent table for revealed exits lands. Pair with 'exits' afterward to confirm what surfaced. When no exit turns up, you look for hiding characters outside your group instead: your perception cuts each one's hiding by a random amount, and whoever is left within your perception is found.
name: search
summary: Search the area for hidden objects, exits and hiding characters.

long: Pays 'proto.cost * sell_profit' rounded (never more than the item's cost) for a carried item the keeper trades in. Equipped items are refused ('remove' first). A keeper with no 'ShopAccepts' rules buys nothing.
name: sell
summary: Sell a carried item to the shopkeeper here.

long: Builder+ (level 101+) only. Skips the rendering pipeline entirely — bytes go straight to the descriptor. Used to surface diagnostic output that already carries ANSI escapes.
name: send
summary: Send raw text to a player's connection.

long: Builder+ (level 101+) only. Run 'set fields' to list every writable field with its aliases. 'stat <player>' dumps the full read-only component state — pair the two when poking at a character.
name: set
summary: Mutate a player field directly.

long: Builder+. Saves the room you're standing in as your recall destination. Persists across logins. Mortals reset their recall via a touchstone item (see 'touch <object>').
name: setrecall
summary: Bind your recall point to the current room (admin).

long: Builder+. Forces a precip kind in the zone's 'WeatherCatalog' entry until the next natural weather tick rolls a new value.
name: setweather
summary: Override a zone's weather.

long: Higher-volume cousin of 'say' (which is room-only). Same Deaf / ignore filtering as 'gossip'.
name: shout
summary: Shout to every online player.

long: Builder+. Categories include 'audit', 'effects', 'weather', 'triggers', 'tickrate'. See in-source for the full list.
name: show
summary: Dump runtime catalogs / counts.

long: Sets SHOW_IDS. Look/inventory renderers that want to surface coordinates check the flag.
name: showids
summary: Toggle showing (zone, id) on entities you can see.

long: Coder+. 'shutdown now' stops immediately; 'shutdown 60 maintenance' announces and counts down 60 seconds; 'shutdown cancel' aborts a pending countdown. Every online player is saved before the process exits; the process manager restarts it.
name: shutdown
summary: Gracefully shut the server down (saves all players).

long: Lighter than 'drink' (4 units). Same refusal on empty containers; same poison handling.
name: sip
summary: Sip 1 unit from a drink container.

long: Changes your posture to sitting.
name: sit
summary: Sit down.

long: Like 'spells' but filtered to kind=Skill. Default shows only what you've learned; 'skills all' dumps the full catalog. Optional substring filter applies to either scope.
name: skills
summary: List skills you know (or the full catalog).

long: Builder+. Writes the row in the target's KnownAbilities. Inserts a new entry when the ability isn't already learned. Proficiency is 0..=1000 (legacy convention). Multi-word abilities work as written or quoted: skillset bob 'sphere of healing' 1000.
name: skillset
summary: Set a player's proficiency in a single ability.

long: Implementor-only. Same death pipeline as combat — corpses, loot drops, triggers all fire normally.
name: slay
summary: Kill a target instantly, ignoring HP / armor.

long: Changes your posture to sleeping. Wake with 'wake', 'stand', 'sit', or 'rest'.
name: sleep
summary: Lie down and sleep.

long: Builder+. Pages through 'AbilityCatalog', sorted alphabetically. With no arg, prints every ability grouped by kind. With a kind label, narrows the list. Pair with 'astat <name>' for per-ability detail.
name: slist
summary: List every ability of a given kind, or all kinds.

long: Pooled slot model (legacy): each circle has 'class+level' slots; casting consumes a slot and queues its recovery. Slots recover one at a time, in the order you cast: the next slot's timer starts only once the one ahead of it is back. They recover on their own under Sleeping / Resting / Sitting postures (faster while Meditating). Format 'Circle N: free/max  (recovering: 12s, 30s)'. Cooldowns persist across disconnect.
name: slots
summary: Show your spell-slot pool and any in-flight cooldowns.

long: Drains 3 stamina and dispatches the SNEAK skill via the data path. Spawns a 'sneak' status effect that wears 'hide' down only slowly as you move, so a sneaking, hidden character passes observers whose perception is below their hiding unseen and unheard. Sneaking alone hides nothing: 'hide' first.
name: sneak
summary: Move silently — keep your hiding as you walk.

long: Builder+. With a player name, starts mirroring their output (every line they receive prints to you with a dim '%' prefix). With no arg, stops the current snoop. Refuses snooping yourself, an equal-or-higher level account, or a player who's already being snooped — one snooper per target. Re-snooping a different target rewires cleanly.
name: snoop
summary: Mirror another player's output to your screen.

long: Builder+. Case-insensitive whole-name match. For substring search use 'ssearch'. The id surfaces on 'varset' / 'skillset' / formula bindings.
name: snum
summary: Print the catalog id for an ability by name.

long: Sorted alphabetically, columnar layout. Use any listed verb on its own (or with a target) to fire the matching social — 'nod', 'shrug', 'smile alice', etc.
name: socials
summary: List every available social verb.

long: Like 'spells' but filtered to kind=Song. Default shows only songs you've learned; 'songs all' dumps the catalog. Use 'perform <song>' to invoke.
name: songs
summary: List bardic songs you know (or the full catalog).

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: south
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: southeast
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: southwest
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: By default shows the spells you've learned grouped by your class's spell circle (1 = lowest). Numeric args filter by circle: 'spells 3' shows circle 3, 'spells 1-2' shows circles 1 through 2. A trailing word filters by name, sphere, or damage type — 'spells 2-3 fire' or 'spells dam'. Add 'all' to dump the full spell catalog (handy for builders); the cross-class catalog has no circle grouping.
name: spells
summary: List spells you know, grouped by circle.

long: Pulls '<amount>' from your wealth and splits it evenly across every group member in your room (including you). Remainder stays with the splitter. Refuses if you're not grouped, the only group member here, or carrying less than 'amount'. Coin amount is in copper; use 'wealth' to check yours.
name: split
summary: Divide coin evenly among same-room group members.

long: Deals 1.5x your damage on the opening swing and engages the target. Refused if you're already fighting or if the target is already in combat.
name: springleap
summary: Out-of-combat leaping kick — 1.5x damage opener.

long: Builder+. Case-insensitive substring against the ability's plain name. Renders '(id) name (kind)' per match, capped at 50.
name: ssearch
summary: Find abilities by name substring.

long: Builder+. Reads 'ShopCatalog' for keeper, accept rules, items offered, pet roster. <id> alone defaults to your current zone.
name: sstat
summary: Dump a shop's metadata.

long: Changes your posture to standing.
name: stand
summary: Get to your feet.

long:
Builder+. Reads every component on the named live entity (player, mob, or item by name in your room) and prints a structured dump. Items print the same block as 'ostat' plus their instance state. 
Note the difference from mstat: stat shows what the entity actually has right now (e.g. current HP, active effects, stored vars); mstat / ostat show the catalog template the entity was spawned from.
name: stat
summary: Dump a LIVE entity's per-instance component state.

long: Does nothing but say so. With the Misdirection spell on you, 'stay <direction>' acts out leaving that way without going anywhere. See 'help misdirection'.
name: stay
summary: Stay where you are.

long: Gated on the Steal skill (the classes that teach it, Thief and Bard in the legacy data). Refused while fighting, against yourself, against a Shopkeeper, and against staff. On failure the target notices and re-aggros on you. Pass 'coins' / 'gold' to grab a chunk of their coin instead of an item.
name: steal
summary: Pickpocket from a target.

long: Costs 6 stamina, deals half your damage, sets the target's posture to Sitting. Default target is your current Fighting target. Refused on already-prone targets.
name: stomp
summary: Knock the target prone (Sitting posture).

long: Moves the weapon in your wield slot into your inventory without the fuss of 'remove'.
name: stow
summary: Quickly sheathe your wielded weapon.

long: Adds the spell to your 'KnownAbilities' at the minimum proficiency tier ('known=true', proficiency=1). Refuses unknown abilities, already-known spells, or off-class spells. Persists across reconnect via 'CharacterAbilities'.
name: study
summary: Permanently learn a spell from your class list.

long: Three tiers: fancy (ASCII-art borders), standard (the default — clean indented lines), and minimal (a single dense line, useful in narrow viewports). With no argument, shows the current style. Currently only score honors this; more commands will follow.
name: style
summary: Choose a UI style for info commands like score.

long: With no argument, lists the subclasses available to your class. With a name (or unique prefix), specializes into that subclass. Requires level 20 (the 'character.subclass_min_level' config) and is permanent once chosen.
name: subclass
summary: List or choose a subclass specialization.

long: Builder+. Reads the (zone, id) MobProto and spawns 'count' (default 1) instances Located on your room.
name: summon
summary: Spawn one or more mob proto instances at your location.

long: Gated on the Summon Mount skill (Paladin and Anti-Paladin from level 15 in the legacy data); refused indoors, while fighting, or when you already have a mount following you. Spawns the first matching mountable proto as a Follower in your current room.
name: summonmount
summary: Conjure a mount (Paladin / Anti-Paladin only).

long: Costs 12 stamina. Deals 1/4 damage to every Standing Mob in the room and sets each to Sitting. Players never targeted.
name: sweep
summary: Sweeping kick — knock every standing mob in room prone.

long: Builder+. Future commands you type dispatch against the mob instead of yourself; output the mob would receive forwards to your connection. Useful for testing triggers from inside a mob and for running RP-as-NPC. 'return' ends the switch.
name: switch
summary: Take control of a mob in your current room.

long:
Builder+. Two modes:
  syslog                 — last 30 entries from the in-memory ring (newest at the bottom).
  syslog <n> [<filter>]  — last n entries (1-500), optionally filtered by level ('WARN', 'ERROR') or a substring matched against target / message.
  syslog watch           — subscribe to live WARN+ events; each new line lands on your prompt as it fires. Same as 'syslog watch warn'.
  syslog watch error     — subscribe but raise the floor to ERROR-only.
  syslog watch off       — unsubscribe. Disconnect also clears the subscription.
name: syslog
summary: Show recent server log lines or subscribe to live errors.

long: Drains 4 stamina and dispatches the TAME skill at the named target. The schema's 'charmed' status effect spawns on the mob; the runtime also installs 'Follower(you)' so existing pet-handling treats it as your follower. Mob charm persists until dismiss or the mob dies — animal-control checks against the will save aren't modeled yet, so v1 always succeeds at the schema-formula amount.
name: tame
summary: Befriend an animal mob into following you.

long: Same charge mechanic as wave but for STAFF items. Useful for buff staves and AOE-style staff effects.
name: tap
summary: Tap a staff to invoke its bound abilities.

long: Reveals the liquid name; on poisoned containers, adds an off-taste hint. No consumption.
name: taste
summary: Identify a liquid without drinking it.

long: Forces the target to focus its attacks on you, regardless of who else it was engaging. Also pushes you to the front of the target's grudge list so it re-engages you first when its current target falls. Costs stamina but no damage — paired with a healer, this lets a tank hold the front line while the dps works behind them.
name: taunt
summary: Pull a mob's aggro onto yourself (tank tool).

long: Builder+. Inverse of 'transfer' (which pulls them to you) and 'goto' (which moves you). The subject is a player or mob by name, 'N.name' or '<zone>:<id>' (a spawned mob instance). The destination is a room ('<zone> <id>', '<zone>:<id>', or a bare '<id>' in your zone) or any visible player, mob or object lying in a room: 'teleport bob 30:12', 'teleport 30:5 3.guard'. You cannot teleport a player of equal or higher level.
name: teleport
summary: Send a player or mob to a room, or to wherever a target is.

long: Reaches one player by name. Refused if the target is offline, has set their 'notell' flag, or is ignoring you. Stamped on the receiver as their most-recent teller for 'reply' and appended to their bounded 'lasttells' log + the persistent 'tell_message' table.
name: tell
summary: Send a private message to one online player.

long: Like backstab but heavier: 2.5x your damage on the opening swing. Costs 8 stamina. Same engagement rules — refused if you or target are already in combat.
name: throatcut
summary: Out-of-combat assassination — 2.5x damage opener.

long: Real-world time, how long the server has been running, and the in-game date and hour. Staff also see the current world tick.
name: time
summary: Show server uptime and the game clock.

long: With no argument, prints your current title. With a new title, sets it (max 60 chars). With 'clear' (or 'none' / '-'), removes it. Persists on disconnect.
name: title
summary: Show or change the epithet shown after your name.

long: Builder+. Lists every trigger in the catalog whose id is in the zone (default: your current zone) with its attach type, event flags and attachment counts.
name: tlist
summary: List the triggers defined in a zone.

long: Builder+. Lists prototypes whose name or keywords start with every word you give, as 'zone:id name', sorted by id and capped at 100 rows. 'vnum' takes a type first (mobiles, objects, rooms, triggers, exits), 'mnum' / 'onum' / 'rnum' / 'tnum' are the same search for one type. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone. Pair with 'vstat', 'rstat' or 'tstat', or jump with 'goto <zone>:<id>'.
name: tnum
summary: Find triggers by name keyword (zone:id).

long: With no argument, lists every toggle with its ON/OFF state. 'toggle <name>' flips one: names are matched like command abbreviations ('toggle auto' reaches the first AutoXxx in the list) and don't need underscores ('toggle showdicerolls', 'toggle dice', 'toggle show_dice_rolls' all work). 'toggle columns <n>' sets the text wrap width (see 'columns').
name: toggle
summary: List your toggles, or flip one on or off.

long: Looks up the named keyword in your inventory or the room. If the object's prototype 'ObjectType' is 'Touchstone', your recall point binds to the room you're standing in. Other object types just refuse — touch is currently a recall-only verb.
name: touch
summary: Touch an object — touchstones bind your recall.

long: Builder+. Looks up entry #N from 'scripterrors' (1 = most recent) and prints the full trigger body alongside the captured error message — so the builder doesn't have to chase (zone, id) → tstat after every failure. The body shown is the *current* catalog row; if the trigger was edited after the failure that text may not match what actually ran.
name: trace
summary: Drill into a captured scripterror entry.

long: BFS through open exits up to 50 rooms looking for a mob or player matching the name. Reports the direction and distance. Closed or locked doors block the scan. No perception check yet — hidden targets are tracked the same as visible ones.
name: track
summary: Find the direction toward a named target.

long: With no arg, lists your current six stats and available practice points. With 'train <stat>', spends 1 point from 'SkillPoints' to raise the named stat (str/dex/con/int/wis/cha) by 1. Refuses on stats already at 18 (the trainable cap), and on no points available. Persists across reconnect.
name: train
summary: Spend a practice point to bump a CoreStat by 1.

long: Builder+ command. The target is a player or mob you can see, by name or keyword; 'N.name' picks the Nth match and '<zone>:<id>' (or 'N.<zone>:<id>') picks a spawned instance of that mob prototype. Moves it to wherever you are (ending any fight it is in). You cannot transfer a player of higher level than you. 'transfer all' (level 102+) pulls every online player of lower level than you.
name: transfer
summary: Pull an online player or a mob to your current room.

long: Builder+. Re-queries the Triggers + attachment tables, atomically swaps the live 'TriggerCatalog' resource, and re-stamps every Room's 'AttachedTriggers'. Mob and object instances keep their current bindings — next respawn picks up catalog edits naturally. Mirrors the '/api/admin/triggers/reload' endpoint so builders can iterate without round-tripping through MCP. Routed through the async dispatcher; the sync stub only fires on dispatcher misconfig.
name: treload
summary: Reload the trigger catalog from the database.

long: Builder+. Mutates 'AttachedTriggers' on the target so a trigger fires for it on the next relevant event. Doesn't touch the DB — survives only this session. Use for builder iteration; persist via muditor when the trigger is ready. <target> is 'here' (room), 'me' / 'self', or a name in the current room.
name: trigattach
summary: Bolt a trigger onto a live entity without reloading.

long: Builder+. Inverse of 'trigattach'. Removes the matching (zone, id) entry from the target's 'AttachedTriggers'. Silent no-op if no match.
name: trigdetach
summary: Remove a runtime trigger attachment.

long:
Builder+. Forms:
  triggers                — list attachments on every entity in the current room.
  triggers here           — same as bare form.
  triggers <name>         — list attachments on a specific mob/item by name.
  triggers <zone> <id>    — look up a trigger by catalog id (alias of 'tstat').
  triggers full [<name>]  — include the trigger body inline alongside each attachment.
name: triggers
summary: Inspect attached triggers on entities or by id.

long: Builder+. Filters the in-memory trigger fire log to fires whose listener was <target> ('here' / 'me' / 'self' / a name in the current room). With no <target>, shows the last <n> fires across all entities. <n> defaults to 20, capped at 200.
name: trighistory
summary: Show recent trigger fires for an entity.

long: Costs 5 stamina, deals 1/4 your damage, sets the target to Resting. Like stomp but cheaper and leaves them slightly less prone.
name: tripup
summary: Trip target into Resting posture (lighter than stomp).

long: Lists your most recent ~21 kill targets and the accumulated kill count per target. Re-killing targets you've farmed scales XP down — the color band on each row hints at how steep the penalty is. With a player name (Builder+), shows their trophy instead of yours.
name: trophy
summary: Show your recent kills (and the XP penalty band).

long: Builder+. Search one table by a field. Run it with only a type (or 'esearch' / 'tsearch' with nothing) to list the fields. Text fields match a substring; 'name' fields match whole-word prefixes of the name and keywords. Number fields take 5, >5, <5, >=5, <=5, !5 or 5..9 (an inclusive range). Add 'in <zone>' at the end to stay in one zone. Flag fields (wear, extraflags, effflags, flags, type, size, sector, ...) take one or more flag names, abbreviations allowed, and match when every one is present. Output is capped at 100 rows. Shops, zones, reset commands and skills are not searchable here.
name: tsearch
summary: Search triggers by name, type, argument, script text or attachment.

long: Builder+. Reads 'TriggerCatalog' and prints flags, body, fire stats. <id> alone defaults to current zone.
name: tstat
summary: Dump a trigger's metadata.

long: Same as 'bug' but tagged Typo. Useful for builders when reviewing room descriptions.
name: typo
summary: Report a typo / wording issue.

long: Builder+. Despawns every 'EffectInstance' whose 'AppliedTo' is the target. Reverses any modifier deltas via the standard expiry path so stat bumps walk back cleanly. <target> is a name in the current room.
name: unaffect
summary: Strip every active effect from a target.

long: Drops the named alias from your list. No-op if no alias by that name exists.
name: unalias
summary: Remove a defined alias.

long: Implementor-only. Inverse of 'ban'. Doesn't delete the row — flips active=false and stamps unbanned_at / unbanned_by for the audit trail.
name: unban
summary: Lift the active ban on a player's account.

long: No-op if you weren't following anyone.
name: unfollow
summary: Stop following whoever you were following.

long: Coder+. Per-character command access. A grant lets a character use one command above their rank; a revoke takes a command away. Only online players strictly below your level, and only commands you can use yourself. 'grant <name>' lists a character's grants and revokes; 'grant <name> clear' drops the ones at or below your level. A mortal can only be granted commands on the grants.mortal_allowlist config row (empty by default), and never an admin command. Command groups and privilege flags do not exist on this server.
name: ungrant
summary: Remove a grant or revoke from a character.

long: Equivalent to 'ignore -<name>'. No-op if the name isn't currently being ignored.
name: unignore
summary: Remove a name from your ignore list.

long: Searches your carried items for a keyword that matches the exit's required key. On match, the door is unlocked (state Closed); use 'open' to then walk through. Refused if the exit isn't locked or you have no matching key.
name: unlock
summary: Unlock a locked door using a key in your inventory.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: up
summary: Walk through an exit.

long: Time since the server booted.
name: uptime
summary: Show how long the server has been running.

long: Wands are pointed at a target (or waved when the spell needs none); staves are tapped on the ground. Each use spends a charge only when the magic lands. The item must be held, and not too powerful for you.
name: use
summary: Use a wand or staff you are holding.

long: Immortal+. One row per online player: name, role, level, current room, idle time and time online. (Peer addresses are not tracked by the runtime yet.)
name: users
summary: List connected players with level, room, idle and online time.

long: Builder+. Syntax-checks each trigger body in the catalog without running it and lists the failures. 'validate_scripts zone <id>' limits the pass to one zone. Also available as GET /api/admin/triggers/validate.
name: validate_scripts
summary: Compile-check every loaded Lua trigger.

long: Searches your inventory and the room for the named item, then prints its base value (the schema's 'Objects.cost') split into denominations. Shops will pay some fraction of this on sell once that lands.
name: value
summary: Show an item's catalog value in coin.

long: Builder+. With <key>, removes that single entry. Without, wipes every variable on the target. <target> resolves the same way as 'varset' / 'varlist'.
name: varclear
summary: Clear one script variable, or wipe the whole map.

long: Builder+. <target> defaults to 'here' (current room). Renders the entity's 'ScriptVars' map sorted by key. Empty maps print a contained 'no script vars' note.
name: varlist
summary: List script variables on an entity.

long: Builder+. <target> is 'here' (current room), 'me' (caller), or a mob/item name in the current room. Stores into the entity's 'ScriptVars' map; reads back via 'varlist'. Lua trigger bodies will (once the binding lands) see the same map via 'actor:varget(name)'.
name: varset
summary: Set a script variable on an entity (Lua-side state).

long: Crate name, version, and the rustc/profile combo the binary was built with. For ops/debug; players will rarely care.
name: version
summary: Show server build identity.

long: Builder+. Async DB load — pulls the Characters row + every CharacterItems row (resolved through the in-memory ObjectPrototypes for names) and prints what they're wearing / carrying. Replaces the legacy 'linkload' use case.
name: viewchar
summary: View an offline character's gear and stats.

long: Drops your hiding: back to normal visibility.
name: visible
summary: Stop hiding.

long: Refuses unless the named owner has added you as a guest via 'house guest add <you>'. Synthesizes the house's ECS rooms on first call (cached in HousingIndex), then warps you to the foyer. Async: the multi-table guest-list + room fetch runs off the world tick.
name: visit
summary: Step into another player's house — guest list required.

long: Builder+. Filters 'ObjectPrototypes' by 'ObjectType' (Weapon, Armor, Container, Light, Scroll, Wand, …). Case-insensitive. Capped at 50 hits with overflow footer; pair with 'ostat' to inspect any one.
name: vitem
summary: List object prototypes by type.

long: Builder+. Lists prototypes whose name or keywords start with every word you give, as 'zone:id name', sorted by id and capped at 100 rows. 'vnum' takes a type first (mobiles, objects, rooms, triggers, exits), 'mnum' / 'onum' / 'rnum' / 'tnum' are the same search for one type. Add 'in <zone>' to stay in one zone. Pair with 'vstat', 'rstat' or 'tstat', or jump with 'goto <zone>:<id>'.
name: vnum
summary: Find prototypes by keyword and print their zone:id.

long: Builder+. Search one table by a field. Run it with only a type (or 'esearch' / 'tsearch' with nothing) to list the fields. Text fields match a substring; 'name' fields match whole-word prefixes of the name and keywords. Number fields take 5, >5, <5, >=5, <=5, !5 or 5..9 (an inclusive range). Add 'in <zone>' at the end to stay in one zone. Flag fields (wear, extraflags, effflags, flags, type, size, sector, ...) take one or more flag names, abbreviations allowed, and match when every one is present. Output is capped at 100 rows. Shops, zones, reset commands and skills are not searchable here.
name: vsearch
summary: Search prototypes, triggers or exits by a chosen field.

long: Builder+. Prints the same detail as 'mstat' (mob) or 'ostat' (object) for a prototype by id. Nothing is loaded into the world. The id is '<zone> <id>', '<zone>:<id>' as 'vnum' prints it, or a bare '<id>' in your current zone. Unlike mstat / ostat, a name is not accepted: find ids with 'vnum' first.
name: vstat
summary: Show a mob or object prototype's stats without spawning it.

long: Builder+. Filters 'ObjectPrototypes' whose 'wear_flags' contain the named slot (Head, Body, Mainhand, etc.). Case-insensitive; matches the 'WearFlag' enum names from the schema.
name: vwear
summary: List object prototypes by wear-slot.

long: With no argument, brings you out of sleep to standing. With a target, finds a sleeping player or mob in the room and stands them up; everyone in the room sees it.
name: wake
summary: Wake yourself, or rouse a sleeping companion.

long: Ends flight (also available as 'walk'). On solid ground you simply touch down. In an air room you have nothing to stand on, so landing there means falling through the down exits until you hit something solid, and the landing hurts (a long drop hurts more; Feather Fall and the Safefall skill soften it). Flight also ends on its own when the fly spell or item that grants it runs out, or when you pick up more than about 95% of what you can carry. You need a source of flight (the fly spell, a winged form or a worn item) to 'fly' in the first place. No-op when you are already on foot.
name: walk
summary: Come down to the ground (stop flying).

long: Prints the current coin total split across the four denominations (1 platinum = 10 gold = 100 silver = 1000 copper). Use 'balance' for bank-stored coin.
name: wealth
summary: Show your on-hand coin in platinum/gold/silver/copper.

long: The item must have a wear-slot, and that slot must be free. Use 'remove' to take something off first.
name: wear
summary: Equip a wearable item from your inventory.

long: Renders a single line based on your current zone's 'Climate' and the in-game time of day. Rule-of-thumb only — no per-tick weather simulation yet, so the same input produces the same output.
name: weather
summary: Atmospheric flavor for your zone's climate.

long: Moves you through the named exit if one is open. Standard directions: n/s/e/w/u/d/ne/nw/se/sw/in/out.
name: west
summary: Walk through an exit.

long:
With no argument, prints your own current room (name, zone, id). With a player name, prints that online player's current room. 'where corpse' tells you where your own corpse lies and which way to go. 'where all' (Builder+ only) lists every online player and where they are.

Immortal+: 'where <name>' also searches live mobs (M lines: [zone:id] name - room) and objects (O lines, including carried, worn and contained ones) whose name or keywords match.
name: where
summary: Show your location, a named player's location, or list all online.

long: Both you and the target see the full text. Other players in the room see that you whispered to them but not what.
name: whisper
summary: Quietly say something to one person in the room.

long: With no args, shows every connected player. With one numeric arg, filters to players at that level or higher. With two numeric args, filters to the inclusive level range. 'who clan <abbrev>' filters to players in the named clan (case-insensitive match against the '[ABBR]' tag shown alongside each name).
name: who
summary: List players currently online.

long: One-line answer to "which character am I logged in as?" — handy after a long session or when a script needs to confirm identity. Pair with 'score' for the full sheet.
name: whoami
summary: Print your character's name, level, race, and class.

long: Equivalent to wear, but only succeeds for items that go into the wield slot.
name: wield
summary: Wield a weapon (shortcut for wear into the Wield slot).

long: 'wimpy 30' enables wimpy mode and panics you out of combat when your HP drops below 30% of max. 'wimpy off' (or 'wimpy 0') clears it. With no argument, prints the current setting. Default threshold when no number was set is 25%.
name: wimpy
summary: Set the HP percentage at which combat auto-flees you.

long: A bare number is copper ('withdraw 50' is 50 copper); add a unit for more ('withdraw 2 silver'). Refuses if your bank balance can't cover the amount. Inverse of 'deposit'.
name: withdraw
summary: Move coin from the bank to on-hand wealth.

long: Builder+ counterpart of 'help'. With no arguments, lists every admin command you can run. With an argument, shows the usage and details for that command — same shape as 'help', but scoped to admin tools so the player help stays uncluttered.
name: wizhelp
summary: List admin commands or show details on a specific one.

long: Builder+. With no arg, toggles invis at your own level. 'wizinvis <level>' sets to that exact level (capped at your own). 'wizinvis off' clears it. Players whose level is below yours (or below the explicit level) won't see you in 'who' / 'look' / 'scan' listings.
name: wizinvis
summary: Become invisible to lower-level players.

long: Shows the immortals who run the game, grouped by rank. A '*' marks staff who are online right now.
name: wizlist
summary: List the staff of the game.

long: Builder+. With no arg, prints the current state. 'wizlock on' blocks non-staff (UserRole < Builder) from completing login; 'wizlock off' clears the gate. Reset to off on every server restart so a forgotten lock doesn't outlive the deploy.
name: wizlock
summary: Lock the mud to staff-only logins.

long: Immortal+. Sent to every online staff member (Immortal or higher). Players never see wiznet traffic. Convention: out-of-character coordination between staff during play.
name: wiznet
summary: Chat on the staff-only wiznet channel.

long: Snapshot of the world state right now: how many zones and rooms loaded, how many live mobs and items spawned, how many players online, uptime (plus the server tick for staff), and active effect-instance count. Aliases 'users' and 'stats' mirror 'world' since the player count and per-system load are the most-asked pieces.
name: world
summary: Live entity counts: zones, rooms, mobs, items, players.

long: Writes the message onto a note-type object you carry or that lies in the room, replacing whatever was there. Anyone can then 'read' it.
name: write
summary: Write a message on a note or paper.

long: Builder+. Sorted by zone id. Use 'znum <name>' to look up the id of a zone you only know by name, or 'zsearch <substring>' for a fuzzy match.
name: zlist
summary: List every loaded zone (id + name).

long: Builder+. Case-insensitive whole-name match. For substring search use 'zsearch'.
name: znum
summary: Print the zone id whose name exactly matches.

long: Builder+. With no arg, resets your current zone. Despawns every mob and object that came from a 'MobResets' / 'ObjectResets' row in the named zone. The next respawn tick (~6s) refills the gaps. Admin-summoned / loadobj'd entities are preserved (no 'FromMobReset' / 'FromObjectReset' marker).
name: zreset
summary: Despawn reset-spawned mobs/objects so respawn refills the zone.

long: Builder+. Case-insensitive substring against the zone's 'Named'. Capped at 50 hits.
name: zsearch
summary: Find zones by name substring.

long: Builder+. With no arg, inspects the zone you're in. Prints zone metadata + entity / mob / item counts.
name: zstat
summary: Dump ECS state of a zone.
